data.name: Subhendu
data.gender_notes: Subhendu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Subhendu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘subh’ meaning good, and ‘endu’ meaning intelligence. This name signifies a person who is intelligent and has good judgment. It is a name for a boy who is wise, courageous, and intelligent. The name Subhendu carries the meaning “Near or with good intelligence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Bengali. Parents who choose Subhendu usually hope their child will grow to embody near or with good intelligence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
